:::{#thm-ci-logodds}

#### Confidence interval for the log-odds

In a [logistic regression model](#def-logistic-regression),
let $\eb$ be the [maximum likelihood estimate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-mle) of $\vb$,
and let $\hat\logodds(\vx) = \dprodf{\vx}{\eb}$.
For large samples,
an approximate 95% [confidence interval](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/inference.html#def-confidence-interval) for the log-odds $\logodds(\vx)$ is:

$$\logodds(\vx) \in \paren{\hat\logodds(\vx) \pm 1.96 \cdot \HSE{\hat\logodds(\vx)}}$$

:::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-logodds-ci, worked in @sol-logodds-ci.

:::
